title: Terms of Change Orders on a Design Studio Selections File
content:
1. **Numbering.** Every set of changes after the first appointment is written as one numbered change order.
2. **Fee-free change orders.** The first buyer-requested change orders, up to the package's number of free change orders, carry no fee.
3. **Fees of later change orders.** The clause under which each later buyer-requested change order carries the package's change order fee while the file is in selection and the package's post-structural change order fee once it is structural closed is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis for change order fees.
4. **Limit.** A buyer may make at most the package's maximum number of buyer-requested change orders. The count is taken over the life of the file and includes buyer-requested change orders only; change orders written to correct a builder error are excluded from it.
5. **Studio or builder error.** A change order written to correct a studio or builder error carries no fee and does not count toward either limit (the fee-free number or the maximum) where the package waives the change order fee for builder error.
6. **State of the file.** A change order is written only on a file whose status is in selection or structural closed, as shown on that file's record.
7. **After drywall.** Once the file is finalized no change order is accepted, because no package permits finish changes after drywall.

**Clause 6 and 7 by status**

| File status | Change order written |
|---|---|
| Awaiting appointment | No |
| In selection | Yes |
| Structural closed | Yes |
| Finalized | No |
| Delivered | No |
| Cancelled | No |

**Clauses 2, 4 and 5 on a hypothetical file** (package with one free change order and a maximum of three)

| Change order on the file | Reason | Counts toward the limits | Fee-free under clause 2 or 5 |
|---|---|---|---|
| First | Buyer request | Yes, 1 of 3 | Yes (the one free change order) |
| Second | Studio error | No | Yes (clause 5) |
| Third | Buyer request | Yes, 2 of 3 | No |
| Fourth | Buyer request | Yes, 3 of 3 | No |
| Fifth | Buyer request | — | Not accepted: the maximum of three is reached |

superseded_clauses: each later one carries change_order_fee_usd while the file is in_selection and post_structural_change_order_fee_usd once it is structural_closed.
